ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a high-intensity (white) focal region at the distal left tip and upper right lobe, creating high local contrast but a low global white-to-black surface ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white cluster at the left lobe tip; multiple scattered low-density white speckles distributed across the dark central and lower regions of both lobes; a moderate-sized diffuse white cluster on the upper right lobe near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal angle of 45-50 degrees relative to the longitudinal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serration along the entire visible trailing edge; distinct high-amplitude jagged peaks concentrated on the inner halves of both lobes adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward-curving concave trajectory from the median notch extending to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel cluster covering the distal tip of the left lobe; smaller white circular pixel clusters visible on the upper trailing section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white pigmentation/scarring localized on the left fluke tip and upper-mid trailing edge of the right fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform distribution of minute white pinprick speckles across the dark ventral surface of both fluke lobes.
